# LiteRT-LM native dependency notices

2026-10-10. These unmodified license texts supplement, rather than replace,
the existing LiteRT-LM/LiteRT licenses. `sources.json` records official URLs,
fixed source revisions, byte counts and SHA-256 of each downloaded text.

The source revisions are from LiteRT-LM v0.18.0 WORKSPACE, and, for Dawn and
XNNPACK, its pinned LiteRT 26895c9fbcc25c43faa8c1a98cd1fd28951602c3.
They are not independently verified build revisions of the Windows wheel.
Dawn's complete LICENSE contains BSD-3-Clause for general code and Apache-2.0
for specified generator/Android files; both are retained. TensorFlow's
complete LICENSE includes its additional third-party notice.

Owners: Abseil Authors; Google / SentencePiece contributors; Niels Lohmann;
David Reid (miniaudio); Sean Barrett (stb); Google Inc. / Skia contributors;
TensorFlow Authors and the additional owners in its LICENSE; MLC-AI /
tokenizers-cpp contributors; Dawn & Tint Authors; Facebook, Inc. and its
affiliates / Google LLC (XNNPACK). Exact copyright lines, conditions and
disclaimers present in the upstream license files are preserved verbatim.

Apache licenses permit source/object redistribution subject to retaining
applicable notices, license text and identifying modifications. MIT and BSD
licenses require retaining their copyright, conditions and disclaimer; BSD
does not permit implying endorsement. miniaudio/stb offer alternative
permissive terms; their complete dual-license texts are retained.

This directory does not assert that every source-declared dependency was
linked, or that these ten notices exhaust the Windows DLL's contents.
See docs/DISTRIBUTION_CLOSURE.md for the remaining specific question about
litert-lm.dll. Missing SBOM alone is not a prohibition on redistribution.
